title: Foundation Models for Generalizable Semantic and Goal-Oriented Communication
abstract: arXiv:2609.07853v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic and goal-oriented communication is increasingly studied for 6G, but generalization beyond seen data remains a key weakness under tight rate budgets. Many existing systems overfit their training data and degrade sharply at very low bit rates because they attempt to compress the entire signal. We introduce Foundation Model-Guided Semantic and Goal-Oriented Communication (FMSGOC), a framework that uses broad visual-linguistic Foundation Model priors to mitigate overfitting. It further improves rate efficiency by concentrating bits on sparse, goal-aligned anchors and relying on generative foundation-model priors to reconstruct the masked regions. By decoupling what to send from how to reconstruct, a vision-language foundation model selects and transmits a sparse set of semantic anchors, while a pretrained diffusion model, fine-tuned for masked completion, reconstructs the image at the receiver. In our experiments, FMSGOC reaches 0

translated_title: 面向可泛化语义与目标导向通信的基础模型
translated_abstract: 语义与目标导向通信在6G领域的研究日益增多，但在严格码率预算下超越已见数据的泛化能力仍然是一个关键弱点。许多现有系统对训练数据过拟合，并在极低码率下性能急剧下降，因为它们试图压缩整个信号。我们提出了基础模型引导的语义与目标导向通信（FMSGOC），这是一个利用广泛的视觉-语言基础模型先验来缓解过拟合的框架。该框架通过将比特集中在稀疏的、与目标对齐的锚点上，并依靠生成式基础模型先验来重建被掩蔽的区域，进一步提高了码率效率。通过解耦“发送什么”与“如何重建”，视觉-语言基础模型选择并传输一组稀疏的语义锚点，而在接收端，一个针对掩蔽补全任务微调过的预训练扩散模型负责重建图像。在我们的实验中，FMSGOC达到了0……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出FMSGOC框架，利用视觉-语言基础模型先验选择并传输稀疏语义锚点，结合微调的扩散模型在接收端重建图像，有效解决了语义通信在低码率下泛化能力差的问题。
